description: Lists every TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, BUG and NOTE comment in the folder, grouped by file, in a sidebar view. Click one to jump to it. Bundled as an example: turn it on, or uninstall it.

commands.title: TODO tree: Go to a TODO…

todoTree.tags.description: Words that mark a comment to list (matched as whole words, case-sensitive).

todoTree.exclude.description: Globs or folders to leave out (besides .gitignore).

todoTree.groupByTag.description: Group by tag (TODO, FIXME…) instead of by file.
